description.p: Sentinel is a native Qt/QML desktop assistant focused on local-first operation, explicit user authority, and visible privacy boundaries.
Optimized for Fedora KDE Plasma 6, Sentinel supports local Ollama model discovery and health checking, key-value memory management, structured transcript persistence, and secure execution boundaries.
Enterprise release pass featuring full Fedora KDE Plasma integration, systemd user service, D-Bus session activation, and native RPM & Flatpak packaging metadata.
